pages.text: The $(item)Filing Cabinet$() holds up to $(bold)8 Manila Folders$(), each dedicated to one item type. It is the primary home for folder-based storage and connects to the $(l:network/network_interface)item network$() via a tube.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: $(bold)Right-click$() to open the cabinet drawer UI. Place folders in the slots — each folder stores a single item type at that folder's tier capacity. Remove a folder to retrieve it with its contents intact.$(br2)When connected to the network, other blocks can insert items and they are routed to whichever folder is locked to that type.

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text: $(bold)Puller Upgrade$() — extracts items from adjacent inventories and routes them into matching folders. If no folder is locked to an item type, the first empty folder is locked to it on insert.$(br2)$(bold)Magnet Upgrade$() — picks up dropped items within 3 blocks and routes them into folders that are $(bold)already locked$() to that type. Unlike the Puller, it will not lock new folders.
